current_scoring_rules.conditions: An actual observation links actual source_ref, subject_refs, source_subject_refs, measurements and native/text/image provenance. source_content/source_annotation/coordinate_mapping are excluded from axis mappings.
Current assessment revision must belong to the interpreted hypothesis; replaced/withdrawn findings are inactive. Assessment states relation, applicability, extent_basis and condition/assumption refs.

CreditPolicy.observation_axes maps kind to one base component: assay_report/biochemical_assay/genetic_phenotype/growth_assay/read_support -> empirical; alignment/profile_match/comparison/gene_prediction -> comparative; structure_match/mechanism/reaction_context -> mechanistic; context_measurement/context/taxonomy_assignment/sequence_composition -> biological_context. Mapping excludes discrimination. Typed hypothesis predicate/value are not examined in this component lookup.

weight = bound applicability weight * bound relation weight * extent factor. Numeric measurement magnitudes (identity, evalue, activity etc.) do not become reliability weights here; query_coverage is an extent factor when no exact mapping applies. Current default applicability: direct1,transfer.6,contextual.35,scope_limited.2,incomparable0; relation: strengthens1,weakens1,mixed.5,does_not_discriminate0. These are existing proxy settings, not proposed or validated constants.

Observed extent clips actual source/native operand geometry. Inferred extent requires explicit bounded target_footprint and cannot be direct; a source reference does not acquire target coordinates. context_allocation requires explicit nonempty original-material allocation in both assessment and account; it is not a measurement. Coverage is not applied twice to an exactly mapped native interval.

For each coherent account and material cell: supported disposition uses strengthening/mixed as positive, weakening/mixed as opposing; weakened reverses those relation roles. Unresolved contributes relation-weighted evidence with unresolved_factor and no opposing row. Component = max(positive weights)/(1+max(opposing weights)). All-zero absence gives0.

Weakened+weakens/mixed yields discrimination; unresolved+weakens/mixed yields factor-scaled discrimination. A supported strengthening row also yields discrimination if the SAME observation weakens another explicit weakened/unresolved hypothesis; derived weight=min(the two weights). Same observation can therefore affect a base component and discrimination. This is existing arithmetic, not another experiment or parent action.

Compatible hypotheses are declared by the episode in coherent_sets. Each cell chooses the whole highest-volume account, not per-axis fusion from incompatible accounts; copies cannot sum. Within a base axis maxima prevent independent evidence accumulation as well as duplicate inflation. No source-family independence model is present.

For existing fixed five axes, H=(product((epsilon+(1-epsilon)*component)^axis_weight)-epsilon^sum_weights)/(1-epsilon^sum_weights). Integrate per-cell H over fixed original eligible position mass, then fixed target weights and bound scale. No candidate-count reward/historical-best clamp. AnnotationSupportScore selects stable equal-component integer-mass integration; old bindings retain their frozen arithmetic.

Separate standard channel: finding_unit * count(distinct current retained typed finding keys actually known to the receiving episode). Key=normalized target question+source claim+qualification; relation/applicability/disposition/episode/account/quotation do not add units. Valid negative/limited findings remain eligible; correction can retire a known key; replacement counts only when received.

Progress normalizes primary metadata DOI/PMCID/PMID, exact XLSX workbook lineage, typed source subjects and explicit same_source_claim_as_ref. It does not infer arbitrary synonyms or independent experiments. Annotation projection uses max within each axis; it does not canonicalize same-study dependency across different base axes. A source_ref alone is custody identity, not proof of independent biological evidence.
